answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 7293 Country: United States of America Title: What is the ruling for a girl to make dua outloud in front of her father, brother, sister, and mother? Question: What is the ruling for a girl to make dua outloud in front of her father, brother, sister, and mother? Answer ID: 7293 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1609/1374=B/1429) As per the Shariah, there is no wrong, dua can be made loudly. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
